extras: Task Dispatch feature is deprecated in favor of the task-file flow.
intentEvidence: OpenAugi is a context engineering layer and personal agent harness for your data
motivation: OpenAugi is about augmented intelligence — using AI to help you think faster and do more, not to think for you.
problem: Users struggle to make their vast, unstructured vault data accessible and actionable for AI agents.

relations.evidence: Works with the OpenAugi MCP server for semantic search, hub discovery, and structured access to your vault data.

summary: Context engineering layer and personal agent harness that uses AI to process vault data, distill notes, and execute tasks.
